title: Power of the Commission to declare a poll void
verbatim_text: If, from each report of the Returning Officer or on the basis of material before it, the Commission is satisfied that, by reason of grave illegalities or violation of the provisions of this Act or the Rules, the poll in any constituency or polling station has been vitiated, the Commission may declare the poll void and order a fresh poll.
provisos: Provided that the Commission shall give the returned candidate and other contesting candidates an opportunity of being heard before passing such order.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Elections Act, 2017 (Act XXXIII of 2017)

title: Scrutiny of nomination papers and qualification/disqualification of candidates
verbatim_text: The Returning Officer shall scrutinize the nomination papers and may reject any nomination paper if he is satisfied that: (a) the candidate is not qualified to be elected; (b) the candidate is disqualified from being elected under Article 62 or 63 of the Constitution; (c) the proposer or seconder is not qualified to subscribe; or (d) any signature is not genuine.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Elections Act, 2017 (Act XXXIII of 2017)

title: Submission of statement of assets and liabilities
verbatim_text: Every Member of an Assembly and Senate shall submit to the Commission on or before thirty-first day of December each year a copy of his statement of assets and liabilities including assets and liabilities of his spouse and dependent children.
provisos: Provided that the Commission shall, on the first day of January each year, suspend the membership of a Member who fails to submit the statement until the statement is submitted.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Elections Act, 2017 (Act XXXIII of 2017)

title: Appointment of Election Tribunals
verbatim_text: The Commission shall appoint Election Tribunals for the trial of election petitions in respect of elections to an Assembly or the Senate. An Election Tribunal shall consist of a person who is or has been a Judge of a High Court.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), Elections Act, 2017 (Act XXXIII of 2017)
